content.body:
The PaK35/36 was the standard German AT gun at the start of the war, having seen successful service in Spain. By the invasion of France however, it was already unable to penetrate the armor on a number of Allied Heavy tanks.
Because of this increasing inadequacy the soldiers dubbed it "the door knocker" ... all it apparently did was knock on the outside of enemy vehicles to let them know you were there. It was however, quite accurate and very mobile, but by 1940 this 37mm AT gun simply did not have enough power to be truly effective.
AT gunners will find that this gun is a pleasure to shoot, as long as you are not shooting at tanks that you can't kill. It is exceptionally accurate with a flat shot and very little dispersion, when ammunition isnt an issue some players have found it serves well as a 1500m+ sniper rifle. If you are shooting at enemy tanks, take advantage of this precision to try to compensate for the poor penetration and aim at vision blocks, turret rings, guns, and tracks. Firing at tanks in general, make sure you have a good shot on a vulnerable spot or on the rear/side aspect.
Being relatively fast to limber/unlimber (deplo) it is nimble on the field. Take advantage of this by relocating frequently.
content.brief: TYPE: AT Gun CALIBER: 37mm WEIGHT: 440 kg TOWING CLASS: Light MV: 760 m/sec PRAC RANGE: 400 m
